headline: Sensex Rebounds 879 Points as IT and FMCG Stocks Lead Market Recovery; TCS and ITC Surge

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: TCS shares jumped 5% after earnings, boosting the entire IT sector
Broad-based buying helped Sensex rebound from previous sessions
All sectoral indices turned green during the day's trade
FMCG sector saw significant gains, with ITC surging up to 5%
whatHappening: Sensex closed nearly 900 points higher, ending the day at 22,536
Nifty 50 reclaimed the 22,500 level as IT and FMCG packs outperformed
Foreign investors pulled $23.5 billion from Asian equities in September due to surging US yields
MV Electrosystems shares have more than doubled from their IPO price in just two months
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a strong rebound on October 9, with the Sensex surging nearly 900 points and Nifty reclaiming the 22,500 mark. The rally was primarily driven by the IT sector, led by a 5% jump in TCS shares following its Q2 earnings, alongside gains in FMCG stocks like ITC. Despite global concerns over foreign fund outflows from Asia, domestic indices turned green across all sectors.
